backtest.assumption_note: Each window is evaluated once, 1 minute after it opens, using the real Kalshi Yes/No quotes at that minute and Coinbase 1-minute / 5-minute BTC candles. Trades use a $4–$8 base stake by signal strength, then 2× after a win (capped at $20), the official quadratic taker fee, and are held to Kalshi’s official Yes/No settlement. The live bot can also enter later in a window (on a 5-minute scan) or exit early if momentum flips; those live extras are not in this backtest.
backtest.fee_note: Paper PnL includes Kalshi’s taker fee: ceil(0.07 × contracts × price × (1 − price)), rounded up to the next cent.

strategy.plain_english: Buys Yes/No when the 1-minute trend is clean, BTC is at least $20 from the strike, the ask is 35–75¢, and 2–15 minutes remain in the window. Requires the 50-period EMA to agree. Requires the 5-minute trend to agree. No extra chop filter.

fee_note: Every paper trade uses Kalshi’s taker fee, ceil(0.07 × contracts × price × (1 − price)), rounded up to the next cent. The Head-to-Head $100 Race starts two books at $100 together (Version 1 Active Multi-Trade vs Version 2 Strict Rules). Existing $40 race books are lifted to $100 by adding the cash delta, so prior trades and P&L stay accurate. The completed 1-hour $40 run and the ongoing $100 book stay in the Trades tab. All books use a $4–$8 base stake by signal strength, then 2× after a win, hard-capped at $20. Every ticket costs $4–$20 (including fees).

rules_summary.buy_yes: 1m EMA 9 > 21, close > EMA 50, MACD hist > 0, RSI 55–70, 5m trend agrees, BTC at least $20 above the strike, Yes ask 35¢–75¢, and 2–15 minutes left.
rules_summary.buy_no: The bearish mirror (EMA 9 < 21, close < EMA 50, MACD hist < 0, RSI 30–45, 5m trend agrees, BTC at least $20 below the strike, No ask 35¢–75¢).
rules_summary.exits: Sell early if the bid reaches 80¢ or +15¢ from entry (take profit), drops 12¢ from entry, or momentum and BTC-vs-strike both flip against the position. Otherwise hold to official settlement.
rules_summary.sizing: Normal qualifying signal $4, strong $6, top-conviction $8. After a win, the next trade is 2× that winning stake, hard-capped at $20 and never more than cash on hand. A $4 win presses to $8, a $6 win to $12, an $8 win to $16, and further wins cap at $20. A loss resets to $4–$8. Every ticket’s total cost stays in the $4–$20 range. The $100 race books, the archived 1-hour $40 run, and the ongoing $100 book each track this separately.
rules_summary.learning: Every hour a GitHub Action studies the last 7–14 days of settled 15-minute windows, walk-forward tests new parameter sets on unseen hours, and only promotes a change when validation P&L is clearly better. That run is free — it does not use Grok Bot.
rules_summary.race: A live Head-to-Head $100 Race compares two books that start together at $100. Version 1 (Active Multi-Trade) can take up to 3 tickets in the same 15-minute window — one new entry per 5-minute check — adding to its side on confirmation or flipping if momentum turns. Version 2 (Strict Rules) follows the learned strategy config and takes at most one trade per window, only when every trend, strike-gap, and price filter passes. Both use $4–$20 sizing and a 2× press, hard-capped at $20.
